name: Silent Kill
prerequisites: Stealth 12 ranks; assassinate advanced slayer talent or ninja master trick
benefit:
When you kill a creature during a surprise round, you can attempt a Stealth check, opposed by the Perception checks of potential observers, to prevent them from noticing your action and subsequently identifying you as the assailant.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 131
When you use this feat, you can spend a number of stamina points up to your Dexterity bonus and gain a bonus on the Stealth check equal to the number of stamina points you spent.
flavor: You are quite adept at killing your prey without making noise or alerting others.
